_README: Project config for tools/board.py (the /work protocol). docs/board.md holds the machine-readable rows; TASKS.md stays the human feature backlog. Run: python tools/board.py lint
_row_id_pattern: MR = market-ready pass. Any bold opener matching this is a row and must carry a header.
_tiers: H = mechanical, wrong-is-visible (Haiku). S = spec-driven build (Sonnet). O = subtle-wrong-is-expensive: data safety, security, gate design, Electron shell (Opus, the foreman).

work.validate: npm test && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run test:unit && python tools/board.py lint
work.validate_counts: backend: passed count (floor 80 until MR-24 lands, then vitest test count); frontend: vitest 'Tests N passed' (floor 93); a count that FALLS is a gate gone hollow

verify.run: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run test:unit

work._verify_ladder: MR-61: runs every gate on a DETACHED worktree at the sha under test with node_modules junctioned in, so in-flight worker edits (source files, not only tests) never poison a verdict. Unlinks the junctions before any removal (CODING-PRACTICES 2.4i).
work._whole_tree_claimants: The Playwright Electron e2e drives a real window: one screen, one driver.
work.commit: one commit per row, explicit paths only (never -A/.), multi-line message via a scratch file + git commit -F; push only to origin HEAD:claude/overhaul-app-functionality-83q0kq (PR #2) and only when asked
